comment: .NET stack, the "gate" section of .kit.json (point it here with "gate": "tools/gate.json"; keys: docs/kit-json.md). dotnet build then dotnet test from the repository root (which must hold the .sln), each through tools/dotnet_each.py, which adds the no-reuse flags (no node reuse, no shared compilation); pass .csproj paths after the verb for a scoped run, or set "cwd" on both steps if the solution lives in a subfolder. The gate books the machine lock itself, so no wrapper is needed.
